author: GameTrailers
description: From across the ocean comes a glorious new world pantheon. Watch the Age of Mythology: Retold trailer to see what to expect with the Obsidian Mirror update, which brings the Aztec civilization to the strategy game. Lead your people under the guidance of powerful Aztec gods, master fear and illusion, and harvest Tonalli, the life force that fuels the gods themselves. The Obsidian Mirror update features a 12-mission campaign that spans continents. From the fall of the utopian city of Aztlan to a myth-shattering journey across Europe and back, alliances will be forged, betrayed, and reclaimed as gods clash and mortals pay the price. Age of Mythology: Retold - Obsidian Mirror is available now on Xbox Series X/S, Xbox on PC, Xbox Cloud, Steam, and PlayStation 5 (PS5).
title: Age of Mythology: Retold - Obsidian Mirror - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Aion 2 announcement teaser trailer for this upcoming open-world MMORPG. Aion 2 will feature flight, as players will be able to fly freely across a world 36 times larger than the original Aion, dive underwater, and engage in aerial combat in PvE and PvP gameplay. Aion 2 will be available on Steam and PURPLE platforms on PC.
title: AION 2 - Official Announce Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for Fantasy World Manager, a creation management simulation game developed by Florian Alushaj. Players will set out to cultivate an expansive fantasy world. Set parameters for quests, creatures, dungeons, and more. Fantasy World Manager is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Fantasy World Manager - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Death must be earned. Check out the Ruiner 2 gameplay trailer for this upcoming cyberpunk action RPG from Reikon Games. The new Ruiner 2 trailer showcases action-packed gameplay and features you can expect, including up to 3-player co-op and the shell system: where you can swap your bodies, pick your roster, and survive. The trailer also showcases character progression, how to develop active skill trees, gearing up your shells, and exploration of Ruiner's universe, including dungeons and conquering wastelands. Ruiner 2 will be available on PC, and you can wishlist on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2936810/RUINER_2/

In Ruiner 2, return to Rengkok. Lightning-fast combat meets a deep, systems-driven world. Master the new Shell System: switch characters mid-combat to exploit lethal synergies and tear through enemies. Play solo or coordinate the carnage in online co-op with up to three players.

Please note: This Gameplay Trailer features pre-alpha footage.
title: Ruiner 2 - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Group 935’s atrocities won't go unanswered. Watch the Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 Zombies Totenreich cinematic trailer for this upcoming update. The Totenreich Round-Based Zombies map and free content update for Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 Zombies arrive on April 30, 2026.
title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 Zombies - Official Totenreich Cinematic Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the Dead Island 2 x Quarantine Zone trailer for this collaboration, which brings a free Dead Island 2‑themed update for Quarantine Zone: The Last Check. The update brings a slice of HELL‑A into Quarantine Zone: The Last Check, allowing players to encounter - and embark on - unique missions on behalf of fan‑favourite Dead Island 2 survivors, including Amanda Styles, Burt Michaels, Curtis Sinclair, Rikki Rex, and Roxanne Kwon. 

Quarantine Zone: The Last Check's update also brings over a dozen new custom survivors with different quirks about them for you to screen when they try to get through.

In Quarantine Zone: The Last Check, command the checkpoint in a collapsing city. Screen survivors, manage scarce resources, and hold back the undead. Every choice matters and one mistake could unleash the plague beyond your walls.

Quarantine Zone: The Last Check is out now on Xbox on PC and Steam, and the Dead Island 2 update is available now.
title: Dead Island 2 x Quarantine Zone - Official Collaboration Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Alien: Rogue Incursion - Part One: Evolved Edition is available now on Nintendo Switch 2. It is also available on PC. Xbox Series X/S, and PlayStation 5 (PS5). It is coming soon to PlayStation 4 (PS4). Watch the Alien: Rogue Incursion - Part One: Evolved Edition launch trailer for this action-horror story set in the iconic Alien universe. Play as rogue Colonial Marine Zula Hendricks, sent to investigate a blacksite on Purdan. Fight and survive using your skill, reflexes, and determination against a deadly Xenomorph incursion in this gripping first chapter of a two-part saga.

#AlienRogueIncursionEvolvedEdition #Gaming #IGN
title: Alien: Rogue Incursion - Part One: Evolved Edition - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Version 1.0 of Below the Crown is out now on Steam. Watch the Below the Crown version 1.0 launch trailer for this game, which is a love letter to Roguelikes, Dungeon Crawlers, and Chess. Prepare for strategy, game-changing spells, psychological tests, and challenges from your fellow players. From the award-winning creators of Duskers & A Virus Named TOM.
title: Below the Crown - Official Version 1.0 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the Blood Hunt PvE Mode Gameplay Trailer for Marvel Rivals, the hit team-based third-person action shooter developed by NetEase Games. Players will stand against Dracula as he dispatches sinister forces to take back New York City. Gather up to four players and make use of their abilities and tactics to fend off the undead doom from taking the Big Apple. Blood Hunt launches on April 23 in Marvel Rivals for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam). 

#MarvelRivals #Gaming #IGN
title: Marvel Rivals - Official Blood Hunt PvE Mode Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Legendary Pilots is out now on Steam. Watch the Legendary Pilots launch trailer for this simulation game. Take off, build your reputation, and chart your own path through a charming retro-styled aviation world. Start with humble routes and work your way up — fly turbo-props and regional jets, manage your fleet, compete in a living airline economy, and shape your own legacy in the skies.

Every decision counts. Every flight matters.
title: Legendary Pilots - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
The hour of reckoning approaches. Watch the Diablo 4: Lord of Hatred launch trailer for this expansion. In the Diablo 4: Lord of Hatred expansion, finish the fight against Mephisto, master the new Paladin and Warlock classes, discover major skill tree updates, and explore an overhauled end game. Diablo IV: Lord of Hatred will be available on Xbox, PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), and PC on April 28, 2026.

#Diablo4LordOfHatred #Gaming #IGN
title: Diablo 4: Lord of Hatred - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: From the creator of indie hits Crypt Custodian and Islets comes Well Dweller, a new dark, bizarre, twisted fairy-tale metroidvania. Watch the new Well Dweller trailer for this upcoming Metroidvania game. Play as Glimmer - a tiny bird armed with a matchstick - who must burn the wicked queen to save his family before they become part of her royal gown. Venture forth into a whimsical but morbid fairy-tale landscape, and battle terrifying beasts whilst gaining new abilities to expand your world. Discover secrets, mysteries, and the riddles that rot in the underbelly of this wretched queendom. Well Dweller will be available on Nintendo Switch and PC, and demo is out on Steam on April 23, 2026.
title: Well Dweller - Official Demo Trailer | Top Hat Studios Spring Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a fresh look at Twinkle's Galactic Tour in this new trailer for the upcoming 3D adventure styled in colorful, 90s low-poly anime aesthetics from developer Molegato (creator of Frogun). Twinkle's Galactic Tour is a 3D adventure game that infuses musical rhythm into its platforming core. Play as Twinkle, an aspiring singer, as she travels the galaxy rescuing her fans following a disaster at her debut concert. True to its musical core, Twinkle's Galactic Tour syncs enemy movements, platforms, and items to the beat and melody of the soundtrack. Twinkle's Galactic Tour will be available on PC.
title: Twinkle's Galactic Tour - Official Trailer | Top Hat Studios Spring Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Motorslice gets a new trailer and a release date announcement. Watch the latest Motorslice trailer for this upcoming parkour action-adventure game. Set within the crumbling remains of a vast megastructure, a girl named “P” arrives with a single objective: destroy every machine inside. Armed with nothing but a chainsaw, she must bring this place down by any means necessary. Parkour through the ruins of a megastructure, climb massive bosses, and hunt down every piece of construction equipment in this slice-of-life game with immaculate vibes. Motorslice will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Steam on May 5, 2026.
title: Motorslice - Official Release Date Trailer | Top Hat Studios Spring Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Metamorphosis announcement trailer for this upcoming brutal 2D pixel art horror action game focused on exploration of a dead world using any tools at your disposal. You play as Aria, a nun branded sinner, seeking absolution. Journey toward the Golden Star to reach the last paradise left in the world. The Metamorphosis will be available on PC.
title: Metamorphosis - Official Announcement Trailer | Top Hat Studios Spring Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Hallow Blade announcement trailer for this upcoming dark fantasy first person action-adventure game from developer Xekvera. Assume the role of a wanderer who forms a fateful, unbreakable bond with the Hallow Blade, an ancient, possessed sword that hungers for revenge - and souls. Focused on strategic, fast-paced first-person combat and deep exploration, you are tasked with overcoming the wrath of a cursed kingdom and its denizens. Hunt powerful foes and feed their souls to your weapon, as it evolves, unlocking new forms and abilities necessary in your journey to destroy the kingdom’s curse. Hallow Blade will be available on PC.
title: Hallow Blade - Official Announcement Trailer | Top Hat Studios Spring Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Delivery Must Complete is a cel-shaded aerial roguelike, mashing together the deep combos of character-action games with the breakneck intensity of arcade flight dogfighting. You’re a Courier with one job: deliver a package through the heart of a chaotic warzone. Pilot your aircraft with reckless abandon, drift, boost, and blast your way through elite fighter squadrons, blimps, mechs, and even dragons. Along the way, unlock upgrades to make your plane even more powerful. Delivery Must Complete will be available on PC.
title: Delivery Must Complete - Official Gameplay Trailer | Top Hat Studios Spring Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Explore the unsettling world of Becrowned in this new trailer for the upcoming psychological, surreal survival horror game which blurs the line between medieval dark fantasy and rotting industrial horror. Step into the shoes of Richard Torrance, a cold and rational man whose pursuit of happiness has led him into a bizarre, dark ages nightmare ruled by the seemingly absent “Omen Raven”, and where his own fears seem to creep into reality from a distant past. Becrowned will be available on PC in fall 2026.
title: Becrowned - Official Release Window Trailer | Top Hat Studios Spring Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Season Echo Overview Trailer for Delta Force, the hit free-to-play first-person action shooter developed by Team Jade. Players will get the rundown on the key updates coming with the latest season, with new modes, an Operations Map Upgrade to Zero Dam, the Akh Canal Warfare Map, new weapons, and more. Season Echo for Delta Force kicks off on April 21 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, iOS, Android, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Delta Force - Official Season Echo Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Orc Incremental announcement trailer for this upcoming incremental auto-battler game. Start with a single orc and build an unstoppable dark army to conquer the realms in Orc Incremental. Perfect your formation, summon mighty beasts, unlock powerful upgrades, and grow stronger with each rebirth. Orc Incremental will be available on PC.

#OrcIncremental #Gaming #IGN
title: Orc Incremental - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Launch Trailer for The Ember Guardian, a twin-stick tower defense shooter developed by Ratbit Games. Players will set out to explore a post-apocalyptic world to gather resources, assemble defenses, and rain lead upon deadly creatures to embody the last remnants of salvation. The Ember Guardian is available now for PC (Steam).
title: The Ember Guardian - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Alpha Gameplay Trailer for Lisia, a co-op psychological horror game developed by Roxych. Players will take their truck across hazardous roads alone or with friends. Customize the truck, lay down bridges for traversal, and head towards the summit. Lisia is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Lisia - Official Alpha Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Announcement Trailer for Kill Breach, a first-person horde base action roguelike shooter developed by Triple DEV. Players will take up arms in a procedurally generated fortress to dispatch the horde. Wield an arsenal of weapons, attain new abilities, and upgrade to infinity. Kill Breach is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Kill Breach - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a look at the Release Date Reveal Trailer for Whirlight: No Time To Trip, a comedic point-and-click adventure game developed by imaginarylab. Players will follow the story of Hector, an inventor who gets thrust into an unexpected adventure with Margaret as reality unravels. Solve puzzles, explore a wide array of locations, and experience a narrative across time itself. Whirlight: No Time To Trip is launcing on May 14 for PC (Steam), with an eventual release on PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch.

#WhirlightNoTimeToTrip #Gaming #IGN
title: Whirlight: No Time To Trip - Official Release Date Reveal Trailer
